description: A container placed by `setblock` takes items from the next command of the same tick, as a datapack function or a console batch runs them: `item replace block` into a chest, a barrel and a furnace right after placing each one. Vanilla creates the block entity inside `setblock`.
setup: item replace block 1 64 1 container.0 with minecraft:diamond 3
item replace block 3 64 1 container.4 with minecraft:oak_log 7
item replace block 5 64 1 container.0 with minecraft:cobblestone 2
